decision_record.calculation: Filter fixture: 1Hour series whose last close is 10h old at decision (> 4x3600s) -> refused; last close 0h old -> passes.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: detect_capitulation reads the served 1H bars with no comparison of the last bar's timestamp to the decision clock; the ENH1 look fixed WHICH expiry is bought (DTE>=2), never WHEN the signal was printed.
decision_record.experiment: Filter-level A/B (gate is the unit; entry production oracle-covered by the port suite): stale/fresh cases above.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution freshness: span-adaptive stale-bar gate on the served 1Hour series (newest close > 4 spans old -> refuse entries; exits never gated).
decision_record.transfer: The capitulation signature (RSI<20 climax + first green bar turning up) is a claim about the LAST closed hour. Entered on a signature printed hours ago, the sleeve buys a 2-7 DTE call on a reversal that has already resolved — one way or the other — without it.

switch: extra.capitulation_options_enh2.stale_bar_gate default ON; OFF restores the pre-change rule exactly
